newsitem.title: FINLAND: IVO SAYS AIMS TO KEEP LANSIVOIMA LISTED.
newsitem.headline: IVO SAYS AIMS TO KEEP LANSIVOIMA LISTED.

text.p: Finnish state-owned energy group Imatran Voima Oy (IVO) said on Friday it aimed to keep electricity utility Lansivoima Oy a listed company although it had become an IVO subsidiary.
"Imatran Voima reports that it aims to keep Lansivoima Oy a listed company, and the development will be continued in co-operation with the other owners," IVO said in a statement.
IVO said its second offer to redeem Lansivoima shares, stipulated by Lansivoima's articles of association, increased ownership to 65.08 percent, up "somewhat more than two percentage points".
"Following the redemption process ... IVO spent some 31 million markka to acquire a total of 140,868 shares of its subsidiary Lansivoima," it said.
"In addition, IVO redeemed convertible bonds entitling to the acquisition of Lansivoima's shares to the total nominal value of 3.5 million markka," IVO said.
